Population is mixed: title says newly diagnosed glioma, eligibility and arm say recurrent malignant glioma. Text says the vaccine is given before maintenance temozolomide after chemoradiation, but temozolomide is not a registered intervention, so it is not listed. Vaccine immune-response measurements are planned (T cells, flow cytometry) but the vaccine is not a candidate, so target_engagement coded no. Phase is EARLY_PHASE1.
